author: yassinyl
description: Network-wide ad blocking and DNS management for your home network.

tips.before_install: Pi-hole needs ports 53 (TCP/UDP) for DNS and 80 for its web interface. Make sure these ports are not already used. After installation, set your router or devices to use this server as their DNS resolver.
tips.after_install: Open the web interface, set an administrator password from the Pi-hole settings, then configure your router or devices to use this server for DNS.

title: Pi-hole
